Maria (CS): Heads-up — Orion dedicated bring-up is next Wed 09:00 PT. We need final quota numbers, autoscale min/max, and a short smoke+soak plan. Who can drive the checklist?
Alex Jenkins: I can own quota calc. Quick question: customer expects 90 p50 latency at 512 tokens, target RPS ~650 peak?
Maria (CS): Yes that's what sales confirmed. Also renewal discussion: they want an ops walkthrough before EOW. Don't want surprises on billing.
Sam E (Infra): I'll own the autoscale policy and load test run. Proposed min=2 pods, max=40 GPUs, scale step=4. Canary at 5% traffic for 15m then 25% for 30m before full shift.
Ian O (Ops): Sounds reasonable. Add a fast-failback policy if backend error rate >2% for 5m. Also need an alert in Console for cost burn > $2k/hr during soak.
Alex Jenkins: Quota math: baseline tokens/session 900, avg payload 350 tokens, expected concurrency 120 -> estimated token/sec ~ (120 * 350)/1 = 42k tps? That seems off, need to confirm session length distribution.
Maria (CS): We have a sample of 200 sessions from customer — I'll upload to the shared folder. For now assume avg seq=300 tokens.
Sam E (Infra): ok recalculating with 300 tokens and 650 RPS -> 195k tokens/sec peak. With quantized model and batching expect ~14k token/sec per GPU, so ~14 GPUs steady, plan for buffer -> set reserved 20 GPUs.
Alex Jenkins: Can we set billing quota to cap cost during soak to avoid surprise? Put soft cap alerts then hard throttle at 120% of reserved.
Ian O (Ops): Yep. I'll add a cost-governor: soft alert at 80%, hard throttle and email to cs+sales at 120%.
Sam E (Infra): Load test plan (short):
```
1) Smoke (10m): 5% canary, simple prompt set A, check p50/p95 and errors
2) Soak (90m): ramp to 50% traffic, varied prompts B/C, observe KV cache hit, batch sizes
3) Stress (30m): burst to 120% expected for 5m windows to test fallbacks
```
Sam E (Infra): Load test command (k6):
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 90m ./orion-loadscript.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
Sam E (Infra): Script will hit /v1/generate with header x-customer-id=orion and trace tags. Use `--env BATCH=auto` so runtime chooses batching.
deploy-bot: loadtest job queued (#orion-load-2026-03-25). ETA start 2026-03-25T16:00Z. :rocket:
Alex Jenkins: Add perf dashboards: p50/p95 tokens/sec, kv_cache_hit, model_queue_depth, cost/hr. Link to draft: https://redwood.app/console/dashboards/orion-dedicated (please request access).
Maria (CS): Action items: Alex final quota + doc by Tue noon; Sam run smoke and post logs; Ian add cost governor and alert policy; I'll schedule customer ops walkthrough and share recording.
Ian O (Ops): Adding runbook snippet for fallback: if error rate >2% and p95 latency >3s -> switch routing to smaller model variant and reduce max tokens to 256, then open incident channel #orion-incident.
Maria (CS): Noted. Also capture customer feedback after soak — 3-question form: latency ok? errors? billing concerns? Will include link in postmortem.
Alex Jenkins: One more: confirm KMS keys for logs are in place (Orion uses customer-managed KMS). If not, we can't ship them logs to their S3.
Sam E (Infra): I checked — KMS configured but key rotation flagged. Will coordinate with security to ensure no interruptions.
Maria (CS): Great. Can someone drop the command and expected metrics in this thread once smoke is done? We want a short exec summary for renewal packet.
Sam E (Infra): Will do. Plan to post short CSV with p50/p95/error/cost-per-hour.
Ian O (Ops): I'll add the alert channels: @Maria (CS), @Alex Jenkins, @oncall (ops).
Maria (CS): Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
